title: Cloudflare shutting down Deno is news, not just PR
content_html:
Requesting the currently-removed post for https://deno.com/blog/cloudflare be restored. Thread: https://lobste.rs/s/8hauxs/deno_is_joining_cloudflare

My reasoning: It isn't just PR, but significant tech news that Cloudflare is buying up open source teams while dismantling the projects they maintain.

Is this not the best place to discuss the ramifications of companies acting in this manner?
